
==Duplication==

We do have a [[:Category:Shadowspawn]] with some articles.  How shall we avoid duplication with what is in this article? Maybe this should only contain an explanation of what shadowspawn are, with a link to the category full of individual articles? --[[User:Gherald|Gherald]] 22:44, 24 March 2006 (UTC)


[[User:Kefkakrazy|Kefkakrazy]] 03:33, 25 March 2006 (UTC) Sounds good to me. That would necessitate the breaking-down of all the subcategories of the Shadowspawn article, and we'll also need to link the existing shadowspawn pages to the Category page. I'll do that now, anyway; it needs done.

[[User:Narvi|Narvi]] 15:53, 26 March 2006 (UTC) Perhaps this article could be a more detailed description? After all, we have learned a lot about Shadowspawn recently. We could write about their history, (making by Aginor, first appearance during the war of Power) general characteristics, (inability to pass through gateways, organization in the Blight) and so on. It's the same argument for having separate pages for [[saidar]] and [[saidin]]. We could include the list, too.

[[User:Narvi|Narvi]] 15:58, 26 March 2006 (UTC) In fact, now that I think about it, it may be better (for organizational purposes) to make shadowspawn a subcategory, and make Constructs a new category. All Shadowspawn are constructs, but not all constructs are shadowspawn after all.

Could we put them in here even though we don't know much about them?
